name: Multi-Query Attention · MQA
tagline: All twelve query heads share one key head and one value head.
description: Every layer keeps full causal attention with 12 query heads of dimension 128, but projects a single key/value head that every query reads. RoPE, the parameter-free QK RMSNorm and the ×1.2 scale act on the shared key once; the fused kernel broadcasts it, so the shared projections receive the sum of the query heads' gradients. Calibrated to 27 layers at FFN 6016 to fit the shared budget.
paperTitle: Fast Transformer Decoding: One Write-Head is All You Need
mechanism: RoPE and QK RMSNorm × 1.2 on the shared key, broadcast to every query head
Full causal attention in all 27 layers; no value embeddings
limitations: Trained from scratch, not uptrained from a multi-head checkpoint. Value embeddings are disabled in this family because their width follows the key/value heads; the matching multi-head control without them has not been trained, so a gap to Dense cannot be attributed to key/value sharing alone. Attention arithmetic is charged per query head, and no KV-cache or decoding saving is measured. Single seed 42; trained from the frozen Others branch, not yet ported to the current code.
